chaetognath.definition: n any worm of the Chaetognatha; transparent marine worm with horizontal lateral and caudal fins and a row of movable curved spines at each side of the mouth

chaetognatha.definition:
n. pl. An order of free-swimming marine worms, of which
   the genus Sagitta is the type. They have groups of curved spines on
   each side of the head.

chaetognaths.definition:
plural of chaetognath
n any worm of the Chaetognatha; transparent marine worm with horizontal lateral and caudal fins and a row of movable curved spines at each side of the mouth

chaetopod.definition:
a. Pertaining to the Chaetopoda.
n. One of the Chaetopoda.
chaetopod.translation: n. [动]毛足动物(如蚯蚓、水蛭等)

chaetopoda.definition:
n. pl. A very extensive order of Annelida, characterized
   by the presence of lateral setae, or spines, on most or all of the
   segments. They are divided into two principal groups: Oligochaeta,
   including the earthworms and allied forms, and Polychaeta, including
   most of the marine species.

chaetotaxy.definition: n. The arrangement of bristles on an insect.
